title: VIXEN configure requires a manual UNDERTOW_ROOT export
body: The first queued cmake -S VIXEN -B build-capdir -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug failed at VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:5 because UNDERTOW_ROOT was unset. I had to locate /home/liory/projects/undertow and rerun through the queue with env UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow. Suggested consolidation: make the VIXEN preset or queue provisioning discover and inject the compatible Undertow root automatically, or fail with the documented path.

title: VIXEN Linux editor builds hard-depend on an absent Windows FidelityFX compiler
body: The queued cmake --build build-capdir --target vixen_editor test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_windowedcapture --parallel 4 reached the editor dependency graph but failed because VIXEN/application/main/cmake/FidelityFXFsr3.cmake:6-7 requires third_party/fidelityfx-sdk-1.1.4/sdk/tools/binary_store/FidelityFX_SC.exe, which is absent on this Linux checkout. No documented Linux/trimmed alternative supplies this compiler, so the editor capture witness could not run. Suggested consolidation: provision a platform-compatible shader compiler or expose a documented editor build mode that does not require the Windows binary.

title: Isolated VIXEN worktrees lack the required CodeGraph index
body: The required initial codegraph explore query reported no .codegraph index in this checkout and directed agents to continue with ordinary tools. I had to fall back to rg and source reads before implementation. Suggested consolidation: provide a maintained index for assigned worktrees or authorize the documented helper to query a canonical indexed checkout.
